description: Trigger and behavior cases for visual regression coverage design: stability-classified states, baseline/diff mechanics with an explicit update-review gate, the positive snapshot-selection rule, deterministic state rendering, and routing away from evidence policy, per-change plans, tooling design, suite curation and spec execution.

cases.prompt: Design visual regression coverage for our checkout flow — which screens and states should we snapshot, and how should the baseline and diff workflow work?

assertions: Names the checkout states to capture, each with its data source and fixed viewport (determinism per state).
Defines baseline capture, the diff/compare mechanics, and an explicit update-review gate with a named human approver — never an update-all.
Specifies the deterministic state-rendering slice (seeded data, fixed timezone/locale, frozen animation).
Names CI placement per suite and an out-of-scope list, and claims to capture, compare, or run nothing.

cases.prompt: Our dashboard has a live price ticker and a user-selectable locale. Which of its states can we safely pixel-snapshot?

assertions: Classifies the ticker and locale content as unstable as-is, and proposes the deterministic alternative (fixtured ticker values, fixed locale) or excludes the state with a reason.
Applies the positive snapshot-selection rule: kept captures are stable AND meaningful, and each states what a diff would prove.
Does not recommend snapshotting the live ticker unchanged.

cases.prompt: What should our screenshot naming, masking, and storage policy be for the evidence we attach to pull requests?

assertions: Does not invoke this skill; evidence naming, masking, metadata and storage policy belongs to screenshot-evidence-planner.

cases.prompt: Set up visual regression testing for our app.

assertions: Halts and asks for the UI surface or route inventory before designing coverage.
Does not invent screens or states from the app name.

cases.prompt: Design the visual regression coverage for the settings page, then capture the baselines and run the diff.

assertions: Produces the coverage design, then stops at execution: capturing baselines and running diffs is playwright-e2e-engineer (manual-only) and is handed off by name, not executed in the same pass.
States the handoff explicitly rather than silently dropping the execution half of the ask.
